package.name: ur5e_description_extras
package.description:
Universal Robots UR5e + Robotiq 2F-85 gripper sim extras for the rl_environments stack. Mounts the UR5e on a 4-legged ur5_base (~0.59 m), adds a cafe table next to it, head-mount Kinect v2, and brings up ros_control with PID gains for the 6-DOF arm + gripper.
Mirrors reactorx200_description's role for the RX200, vx300s for the ViperX, and ned2 for the Niryo — keeps RL packages free of URDF and launch noise while letting the description ship independently for MoveIt / RViz / standalone simulation.
